name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for Seahorse
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the real-world need, not the
proposed solution.

## Proposed behaviour

What you would like Seahorse to do. Keep it concrete enough that a maintainer
can judge scope.

## Alternatives

What have you considered instead (workarounds, other tools)?

## Impact

- Who would benefit?
- Is this core (the memory engine / agent surface), or an add-on?
- Rough effort estimate, if you have one (small / medium / large).

## Additional context

Any links, prior art, or notes.
